target.statement: LLM-NEO achieves an average score of 63.88 on 5 reasoning benchmarks when distilling Llama 3.1-8B into Llama 3.2-1B, outperforming SFT, LoRA, and KD.
target.table_ref: Table 2, row 'Avg.', column 'LLM-NEO', first sub-table (Llama 3.1-8B -> Llama 3.2-1B)

compute.basis: Training requires 6 A100 40G GPUs for ~1 hour; on a CPU-only laptop, training would be infeasible within a few hours, and even with a single GPU, memory and time constraints make reproduction impractical.

blockers: Large models (Llama 3.1-8B teacher, Llama 3.2-1B student) need significant GPU memory
Evaluation on 5 benchmarks requires running lm-evaluation-harness, which is time-consuming on CPU
title: LLM-NEO: Parameter Efficient Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models
